task.goal: In Simple Gallery Pro, copy receipt_copy_proud_monkey.jpg in DCIM and save a copy with the same name in Download
task.final_summary: I copied receipt_copy_proud_monkey.jpg from DCIM into Download in Simple Gallery Pro. The copy kept the same name: its Properties show Name "receipt_copy_proud_monkey.jpg", Path /storage/emulated/0/Download, size 14.6 kB, matching the original in DCIM. The folder list now shows 1 item in DCIM and 1 in Download.

steps.note: Observe current screen; find Simple Gallery Pro skill or launch app
Launch Simple Gallery Pro and observe its screen
Open DCIM folder and view its contents
Long press the DCIM image to select it, then choose Copy
Toggle filename visibility to confirm the file name
Open the selection More options menu to find Copy
Open Properties to confirm filename is receipt_copy_proud_monkey.jpg
Tap More options then Copy to and pick Download folder
Choose 'Copy to' from the selection menu
In Copy to folder picker, choose Download and confirm
Use 'Other folder' picker to navigate to Download
Navigate breadcrumb to Internal root to find Download folder
Enter Download folder in picker, then confirm OK to copy
Confirm OK on the folder picker to copy into Download, then check for result toast
Exit selection mode and go back to folders to open Download and verify the copy
Back to folder list, open Download, verify the copied file exists
Open Download folder and verify the file name via Properties
Long press Download item and open Properties to confirm name and path
Open More options and choose Properties to confirm the copy's name and path
Read Properties of the Download item to confirm name and path
Tap OK to close Properties, then exit selection mode and confirm final screen
Exit selection mode with Done and confirm Download shows one item
Press back to exit selection mode and confirm the Download folder screen
Task complete; no further steps
